game_concept: A arcade set in Coastal Port – Rope Walk, the rope-makers' walk: the sailor must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – And/Or Locks: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues.
theme: Coastal Port – Rope Walk: the rope-makers' walk
core_gameplay_loop: In Rope Walk, repeat each round: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues. Each round, a new cannonballs challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the lock_progress value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 420 points of cannonballs by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 420, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 9 (extended tier): And/Or Locks
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'And/Or Locks' (Week 3 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Rope Walk'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_progress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Rope Walk.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 420 within 54 seconds.
